description: The Reserve Model (TheRS) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by THEMA Consulting Group. As TheMA, but in addition analysing reserve markets. Coverage: Peru, Türkiye. Time resolution: 15 min, 1 min, Can be specified by user; also period for model horizon can be controlled by user. Spatial resolution: global, continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, power stations. Software: GAMS; CPLEX (or other commercial solvers like GUROBI; XPRESS; open source solvers possible; but then with reduced model scope). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
